answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity bond with slashing. Each agent locks yarrow as collateral before it can bid for work. Random audits sample agents each epoch; a cheater loses its bond at the inlet, while honest agents earn fees that compound over a longer horizon. Because the bond is charged per identity, an attacker fabricating N fake agents must lock N separate bonds, so the cost grows linearly with the Sybil count and mass impersonation becomes unprofitable.
